title: measurement_study_v1 reviewer response file
description: Exported by the offline review viewer. One file per reviewer per stage. Stage A asks target presence and scene quality; stage B asks a structural-deformation comparison against a shown original reference.

export_kind.description: Only 'final' files are admitted to the primary analysis. A 'draft' may be used to resume a session.

reviewer_alias.description: Coordinator-assigned alias. Must not contain a name, email or other identifying detail.

prior_exposure.description: Self-declared. Recorded honestly; it is not a disqualification and is reported, not used to silently drop a reviewer.

neutral_id.description: Opaque item id. Carries no arm, method, prompt, seed or source information.

position.description: 1-based position in this reviewer's presentation order.

target_presence.description: Stage A only. null means not answered. 'uncertain' is a real answer and is never coerced to present/absent.

scene_quality.description: Stage A only. null means not answered.

deformation_vs_reference.description: Stage B only. null means not answered.

x_notes.missingness: A response row is always emitted for every item in the package, with nulls where the reviewer did not answer. Missing answers are never inferred, defaulted or back-filled.
x_notes.identifiability: The file intentionally contains no name, email, IP, timing trace, user agent or machine score.
x_notes.stage_separation: A viewer refuses to import a file whose stage, package_id or schema_version does not match its own.
